messages:
Rhea (People Ops): All-hands in ~18m. Tiny thread for a couple last-minute logistics items: live-stitching YouTube + internal, slide corruption backup, captions, and post-meeting deliverables. Green room 14:10.
Jon (AV-Engineer): Bringing switcher, two laptops, and a cold spare. Testing live-stitch to both YouTube + internal RTMP now. If main NDI -> YouTube fails, we'll stitch to internal first then re-publish.
Kai (Eng-Runtime): Heads-up for live-stitch: make sure the ingest stream keys are unique per destination. I'll watch routing and drop-in a health-check script: `curl -fsS https://ingest.redwood/health || echo FAIL`.
Maya (Product): Small slide issue: one slide with an animated SVG flickered in rehearsal. I'll upload a static PNG fallback to the deck. Please use the PNG if animation causes a crash.
Sam (CEO): OK on static fallback. Quick ask to presenters: please keep slides tight so we have 20m for Q. I'll monitor both this thread and the questions doc.
CaptionBot: Captions online  latency ~2s  confidence 0.90. Will fallback to local VTT if confidence drops <0.6.
Jon (AV-Engineer): If the YouTube ingest drops but local recording continues, we'll trigger a manual re-ingest and post `:warning: youtube re-ingest in progress` here. Also bring TRRS adapters.
Rhea (People Ops): Link to questions doc: https://docs.google.com/.../all-hands-questions. Put product-specific Qs in the sheet, general ones here. Tag with 'leadership' or 'product'.
Kai (Eng-Runtime): If OBS shows dropped frames, switch encoder to NVENC and lower canvas to 720p. Also kill duplicate ffmpeg if CPU spikes: `ps aux | grep ffmpeg` then `kill -9 <pid>`.
Maya (Product): Confirmed PNG fallback uploaded at slide index 14. Also moving "Private GA" Qs to the start of the Q block so leadership can address them first.
Sam (CEO): Noted. We'll open with private/Governance Qs.
Jon (AV-Engineer): One more: we're enabling local live-stitch markers for clip insertion (T+10 and T+25). If clip insertion fails, we'll note timestamps and insert clips into the recording post-show.
DeployBot: Recording started  writing to gs://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1834567890/session.mp4
Rhea (People Ops): Two-minute warning will be posted here and I'll send an in-room cue. Presenters please do a 5s mic test in the green room.
Kai (Eng-Runtime): Quick watcher for the team: `while true; do curl -s https://ingest.redwood/metrics | jq '.streams[] | select(.name=="allhands")'; sleep 15; done`  will paste errors if I see them.
Jon (AV-Engineer): If live captions desync, switch overlay to prepped VTT and note `:warning: captions fallback active`.
CaptionBot: Caption confidence metric: 0.88. Monitoring drift.
Maya (Product): Post-meeting action: product will collect top 5 roadmap questions and owners within 48h and post a 1-pager.
Rhea (People Ops): Legal reminder: if you show any customer data mark slides "CUSTOMER CONTENT" and send to legal-review@redwood.ai. We'll fast-track approvals where possible.
Sam (CEO): Thanks team. Keep answers short during Q so we can handle follow-ups offline if needed.
Jon (AV-Engineer): If we have to stitch recordings after the show, I'll annotate the local file with slo markers and publish the stitched master to gs://redwood-recordings/after-legal.
RecordingBot: Local recording OK  path /mnt/ssd/all-hands-1834567890.mp4
Rhea (People Ops): Final: follow-up summary + action items posted to #all-hands within 2 hours. Good luck everyone! :sparkles:
